title: Shared definitions for KenGranderson.com content records

id.description: Stable identifier. Lowercase kebab-case, and must match the file name without .json. Never change it once published; other records link to it.

partialDate.description: A date at the precision actually known: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD. Do not invent precision.

status.description: draft: work in progress, never published. review: ready for Ken's review, never published. published: approved for the public site (requires approval).

reference.description: A link to another record as <collection>/<id>, for example work/my-bed-stuy.

media.description: Supporting media. Use path for files inside the KenGranderson site folder (checked at build time) or url for external media.

sources.description: Provenance: where the information in this record comes from, so it can be verified.

verified.description: true only when someone has checked the claim against this source.

approval.description: Who approved publication, and when. Required for status published.

editorNotes.description: Internal notes for editors and agents. Stripped from published output.
